about: What lvgl26 covers of the toolkits people migrate from. The status page is written from this file by tools/migration_matrix.py. A skill or a person reads it to see what a port can use and what is missing.

gaps.title: Components
gaps.what: Reusable parts with their own state, parameters and slots, used several times in a tree.
gaps.design: researched: docs/research/components.md; the design interview comes first

gaps.title: Lists and repeaters from a model
gaps.what: A list, a repeater or a scroll list built from a model that changes, with a fixed capacity on small devices.
gaps.design: built for a fixed capacity: docs/lists.md, docs/research/lists.md; recycling and sorted views are planned

gaps.title: Translations and text resources
gaps.what: Text per language, plural forms and a switch of language at run time.

gaps.title: A style that follows a state
gaps.what: A style property bound to a state, so a theme or a look can change in place instead of mounting the tree again.
unblocks: the three looks of the Qt treadmill

gaps.title: More gradients
gaps.what: Diagonal gradients and gradients with several stops. Today a gradient is vertical or horizontal with two colors.
unblocks: the printer panel's tiles and color button

gaps.title: Animate a widget's opacity
gaps.what: A fade of a whole widget. LVGL has no setter for it, so lv::animate has no member for it.
unblocks: the splash fades of the Qt treadmill

gaps.title: Bind position and size to a state
gaps.what: Follow a state with x, y, width and height, and with a text that formats several values.
unblocks: moving a dot along a track
a time such as 6:05 in one binding

gaps.title: Children that a widget creates itself
gaps.what: The add calls of LVGL as nodes: list items, tabs, message boxes, menu pages.
gaps.design: decided: a child-creating add function becomes a node, such as lv::list_button

gaps.title: Charts and results that are not widgets
gaps.what: Chart series, scale sections and other things that an add call returns that are not widgets.

gaps.title: Several values in one property
gaps.what: A property that takes an index and a value can take a list of them: the cells of a table.
gaps.design: decided: a list of tuples for any multi-argument setter

gaps.title: Arrays of flags
gaps.what: An array of control flags per button, written without LVGL's C enumerators.

gaps.title: Parts that are widgets, and joins between widgets
gaps.what: Reach the list of a dropdown, join a keyboard to a text area by id, and align a widget to another one.

gaps.title: A style for one part in one state
gaps.what: The knob of a slider while pressed: lv::on("knob", "pressed", {...}), in a node or in a theme.

gaps.title: A name beside other values, and the roller
gaps.what: A quoted enumerator beside a string, a state that follows a roller or a dropdown, and unsigned setters that refuse a negative number.

gaps.title: SVG, Lottie and animated pictures
gaps.what: Vector pictures and pictures that move, decoded or made by the compiler.
unblocks: Qt Image with an SVG source

gaps.title: Canvas drawing and draw events
gaps.what: Draw into a canvas and react to draw tasks without the C API.

gaps.title: Pointer input and drags
gaps.what: The movement of a pointer during a drag, as a typed value.

gaps.title: A window display without C
gaps.what: An SDL window and a mouse as objects of lv::, like lv::display.
unblocks: the window examples need no C API line

gaps.title: A page switcher in the library
gaps.what: Switch and slide pages, with the old page deleted. Today it is a small header inside each example.

gaps.title: Live preview that reloads on save
gaps.what: A dev server that rebuilds on save and shows the screen in a browser, with a tree inspector and click to source. An SDL window second.
gaps.design: decided: browser first, then an SDL window

gaps.title: Design tools through agents
gaps.what: Tokens and layouts from Figma, Penpot and Claude Design, written by an agent and checked by the compiler.
unblocks: a design file as the source of a port

gaps.title: Migration skills and helpers
gaps.what: Claude skills for each source toolkit, with scripts that list screens, assets, fonts and colors and write the token file.
unblocks: a port of a whole app by an agent

gaps.title: A real board and a size budget
gaps.what: The slice running on hardware, with flash and RAM numbers that a test keeps from growing.
unblocks: every TouchGFX and Qt for MCUs user who asks for numbers

gaps.title: A fixed memory region for a screen
gaps.what: A screen that takes its memory from a region the program names, and says how large it must be.

gaps.title: A drag and drop editor
gaps.what: A visual editor that writes lvgl26 trees. The live preview and the design tools take its place.
